propositions: push non-fast-forward recovery aborts when an untracked local file collides with a file the merge wants to create, leaving the untracked file in place and failing all retries
_recover_dirty_merge sets tracked changes aside via stash commit, clears tracked changes with git reset --hard, but does not handle untracked files that collide during merge
untracked-overwrite collisions in push recovery should be recoverable by quarantining named colliding paths and retrying the merge once, matching the pattern used in reconverge
the stash commit must be restored exactly once on every exit path (success, retry-failure, non-recoverable abort) to preserve tracked edits
recovery implementation must reuse the shared sync parser for abort-named paths and the shared quarantine directory shape without calling sync's mover across module boundaries
push_recovery must late-bind core._git for the quarantine move operation to preserve the ~25 existing test monkeypatch sites
